tasks.label: Install native build dependencies (Ubuntu/Debian)
tasks.detail: Install the compiler, pkg-config, GTK/GLib, and Ayatana AppIndicator development packages. Prompts for your sudo password in the terminal.

tasks.label: Install GoReleaser
tasks.detail: Install the latest GoReleaser v2 into GOBIN (or GOPATH/bin). Run once before building packages; requires Go and internet access.

tasks.label: Build Debian package
tasks.detail: Build amd64 .deb, .rpm, and .tar.gz artifacts in dist/ without publishing. Clears dist/ first. Requires GoReleaser and GTK/AppIndicator build dependencies.
tasks.command: goreleaser_bin="$(go env GOBIN)"; if [ -z "$goreleaser_bin" ]; then goreleaser_bin="$(go env GOPATH)/bin"; fi; "$goreleaser_bin/goreleaser" release --snapshot --clean
